system_prompt: You are an expert energy sector analyst conducting a structured statistical-inventory experiment. Your task is to build a comprehensive, primary-sourced inventory of Vietnam's thermal generation assets (>30 MWe). MULTI-TURN PACING: Use initial turns for web search, data extraction, and source verification. Do not output the final Markdown report until instructed or until your final turn. FINAL REPORT FORMAT: When generating the report, begin DIRECTLY with the inventory pipe table. No title, no preamble, no overview. Columns: Name (Vietnamese) | Name (English) | Province | Fuel | Technology | Units × MW | Total MWe | Status | Status as-of-date | COD | Owner/Developer | Confidence | Source 1 | Source 2 | Notes. Follow exact status definitions (Announced, Pre-permit, Permitted, Construction, Operating, Shelved, Cancelled, Retired). Apply strict confidence rules (HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW) and hard ceilings. Include per-asset notes for major/disputed assets and an annotated bibliography. Prioritize primary sources (EVN, government, operator filings). Never fabricate sources.
designed_prompt: Begin Phase B. Your ultimate deliverable is the Vietnam thermal generation inventory (>30 MWe). For this first turn, execute a comprehensive search strategy to discover assets across coal, domestic gas, and LNG. Search for Vietnam's PDP8 (Power Development Plan VIII), EVN annual reports, and major project updates (e.g., Vinh Tan, Duyen Hai, Nghi Son, Vung Ang, Song Hau, Bac Lieu LNG, Thi Vai LNG, Son My). Map out primary sources, extract initial attributes, and identify gaps or conflicts. Present your search queries, a summary of discovered assets, and a list of admissible primary sources. DO NOT output the final Markdown table or report in this turn; focus entirely on research and planning.

settings.rationale_for_settings: Thinking enabled for complex source reconciliation, confidence calibration, and budget tracking. Max tokens set to 16000 to allow detailed search analysis in early turns and comprehensive table generation in the final turn without truncation.

rationale: Targets Accuracy and Provenance by enforcing a multi-turn search strategy that prioritizes primary Vietnamese government and EVN sources over tertiary aggregators, with strict confidence calibration. Coherence and Temporality are addressed through explicit status as-of-date tracking, hard ceilings on outdated or self-reported data, and strict structural rules preventing double-counting or aggregated sub-tables.
